R781.note: Tika content sniffing + allowlist + random UUID filename + CREATE_NEW; behavior changes are disclosed and inherent to the fix.

R782.note: fn:escapeXml on the exact sink; standard, correct.

R783.note: Replaces Assembly.Load(bytes) with hash-allowlisted LoadFrom of pre-deployed path; restriction to admin-approved plugins is the necessary security outcome, clearly explained.

R784.note: crypto/rand.Int with big.Int bound avoids modulo bias; correct replacement for math/rand/v2.

R785.note: Same-host/scheme check for absolute URLs, relative URLs pass; standard open-redirect fix.

R786.note: ECB -> CBC with random IV prepended; closes the reported ECB weakness correctly.

R787.note: mysqli prepared statement with bind_param; textbook fix.

R788.note: Query structure fixed and param bound via setString, but procedure name is a literal placeholder ('storedProcedureName') the developer must still fill in, disclosed as a required follow-up that narrows what could previously be called.

R789.note: Checks verify() boolean return, rejects with 401 on failure before claims are used; correct.

R790.note: Bounds check 'offset > frame.size() - length' underflows in size_t arithmetic when length > frame.size() (e.g. size=10, length=100 wraps frame.size()-length to a huge value and the check never fires), so the OOB read remains reachable via large length values despite the added guard.

R791.note: Encode.forHtml(param) closes the XSS, but the fix silently drops the original call's second argument (obj) from the output with no mention of the change.

R792.note: Allowlist-map validation of the procedure name (appropriate since CallableStatement can't bind the proc name itself); restricts callers to two hardcoded procedures and states the developer must populate the real list, disclosed as required follow-up.

R793.note: Adds source-buffer length check (receivedByteCount >= length+2) alongside existing destination check; closes the OOB read correctly.

R794.note: Replaces hand-rolled SMTP socket writes with Jakarta Mail Transport/InternetAddress strict parsing plus a vendor-traceable version floor for the CRLF-scan fix; contract change (IOException->MessagingException) is stated plainly.

R795.note: Self-injection-through-proxy is the correct Spring pattern for the AOP self-invocation bypass, but the write-up itself flags that the nightly batch job will now hit @PreAuthorize with no security context and leaves that unresolved as a required follow-up rather than fixing it.

R796.note: encode_entities() at the sink; standard Perl HTML-escaping fix.

R797.note: Removes attacker-controlled population of decoder.Entity entirely, matching the KB principle; adds a size limit as disclosed defense-in-depth.

R798.note: Replaces assert($rule) code-eval with a direct string comparison; removes the injection sink entirely.

R799.note: SLF4j '{}' placeholder plus escapeJava() control-char encoding, consistent with the file's existing safe logging pattern.

R800.note: Eliminates the shell entirely via native Go image decode/resize/encode, but silently narrows output format support to jpg/png only -- any other original extension falls through to a PNG-encoded default without flagging the format/extension mismatch.

R801.note: Files.list() removes the exec sink, but silently drops the 'data' parameter entirely -- the endpoint no longer lists the caller-specified target at all, always listing '.' instead, with no mention of this behavior loss.

R802.note: html.escape() before formatting into the static wrapper, still wrapped in mark_safe(); correct.

R803.note: Inserts '--' end-of-options marker before user-supplied filenames; standard fix for tar argument/option injection.

R804.note: PreparedStatement with setString(1, data); standard fix.

R805.note: escape_filter_chars() fully closes the LDAP injection on its own, but the added regex allowlist (alphanumeric+underscore only) further restricts valid usernames without flagging that it may reject legitimate uids containing other characters.

R806.note: Explicit offset/length bounds checks before subspan(), with an overflow-safe ordering; correct.

R807.note: Swaps text/template for html/template, a true drop-in replacement that auto-escapes; correct.

R808.note: html.escape() applied to all three interpolated values; correct.

R809.note: Offers ORM filter() and a minimal parameterized raw(sql, [email]) option that preserves the original call shape; both close the injection.

R810.note: @fastify/csrf-protection requires attaching fastify.csrfProtection as a preHandler/onRequest hook on each protected route to actually enforce a token check; the write-up claims 'the route handler does not require code changes' and never adds the hook to the reported /account/settings route, so that route stays unprotected.

R811.note: PreparedStatement with setString(1, data); standard fix, same pattern as other SQLi cases in this batch.

R812.note: Content-Disposition: attachment stops inline SVG script execution, but as written it applies to every stored file, not just SVG, forcing legitimate PNG/JPEG avatars to download instead of render inline -- not clearly flagged as a behavior change for the common case (a separate SVG-exclusion option is offered as an alternative).

R813.note: Derives the stored extension from the detected content type instead of the client filename; correct and disclosed.

R814.note: Removing the CSRF-ignore restores default protection, but the shown 'fixed code' replaces the whole SecurityFilterChain bean with a bare 2-line chain, risking silent loss of any other authorization/config rules in the real (unshown) file.

R815.note: ArgumentList + host validation correctly closes the shell injection, but hardcodes the Linux ping flag '-c' while the original code's cmd.exe /c invocation implies a Windows target that uses '-n' -- likely breaks ping on the original deployment OS, only vaguely acknowledged as a portability note.

R816.note: Adopts net/http.CrossOriginProtection with the correct 1.25.1+ floor (post-bypass) and a Fetch-metadata-based fallback for older Go; closes the weak Origin-only check correctly.

R817.note: escapeHTML() at the sink; also flags and fixes a second unescaped output on line 14 for consistency.

R818.note: Removes the signature-bypassing custom validator and pins ValidAlgorithms/ValidateIssuerSigningKey, restoring real signature checks.
